name: Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy)
summary: Discover parsimonious ODE vector fields from measured trajectories using sparse regression.
core_idea: Construct a library of candidate nonlinear terms and find a sparse coefficient matrix fitting estimated time derivatives.
innovation: Produces interpretable equations rather than black-box dynamical transition networks.
limitations: Fails if relevant terms are missing from the candidate library.
Numerical derivatives and sparse coefficient estimates can be sensitive to noise.

start_here.why: Original sparse-equation-discovery framework with clear numerical examples.
start_here.focus: Dictionary matrix, sparse regression and governing-equation recovery.

curation_note: Scholarly source and method contribution checked; starting references are suggestions, not mandatory reading.
